race.comment: Keen to see the progressive GOLD CHARIOT (11) step out again. He won by an effortless eight lengths two back at Pakenham Synthetic, backing it up with an impressive victory from a mile back at Sandown Lakeside last time. Can keep the ball rolling. FEDERER (4) has been good in all three runs back and should be peaking now. If he can hold a spot from the inside gate he'll be right there. EMPEROR TZU (10) backs up quickly off a good win over this route last time out. He was behind GOLD CHARIOT prior but is in the mix again. Of the rest, JUST TOO FLY (8) comes in next best off his run two back but form either side has been awful.
